script: When can college coaches actually reach out? In Division One soccer, recruiting calls, texts and messages can't start until June fifteenth after your sophomore year. But coaches are watching way before that, at camps, showcases and on film. So don't wait for the DM. Build your film and your grades now.
caption:
When can college coaches actually contact you? 📲

Under NCAA Division I rules for men's and women's soccer, coaches can't start recruiting calls, texts or messages until June 15 after your sophomore year. That doesn't mean they aren't watching: camps, showcases and your highlight film all count before that date.

Save this for your freshman or sophomore year, and send it to a teammate who's thinking about college soccer. Rules can change, so always confirm on ncaa.org.
